title: 10% off Ultimate gift cards at Coles
description: Save 10% on the face value of select Ultimate gift cards in-store at Coles. Limit 5 cards per customer. Stacks with your regular Flybuys earn on the discounted amount.
terms: Limit 5 cards per customer. In-store at Coles only.

title: 10x Everyday Rewards on Mastercard gift cards at Woolworths
description: Earn 10 bonus Everyday Rewards points per dollar on $50 and $100 Mastercard gift cards at Woolworths — equivalent to 5 Qantas Points per dollar spent. Note: $5.95 activation fee per card applies.
terms: Limit 5 cards per day per member. $5.95 activation fee per card applies.

title: 20x Everyday Rewards on Apple gift cards at Woolworths
description: Earn 20 bonus Everyday Rewards points per dollar spent on Apple gift cards at Woolworths. Limit 10 cards per member per day.
terms: Limit 10 cards per member per day.

title: 1,000 bonus Flybuys on selected gift cards at Coles
description: Earn 1,000 bonus Flybuys points on $100/$200 eftpos, TCN Gift, Him, Choice and Baby gift cards, and $50 TCN Kids, Teen and Cinema cards at Coles. Best value on the $30 Cinema card.
terms: Limit 5 cards per Flybuys account. Selected denominations only.

title: IHG One Rewards — 100% bonus on points purchase
description: Buy IHG One Rewards points with up to a 100% bonus, making the effective cost around 0.5 US cents per point. Maximum 150,000 points per calendar year. Good for topping up before a free night redemption.
terms: Maximum 150,000 points per calendar year. Price in USD.

title: 30% bonus Velocity Points on hotel transfers
description: Transfer points from Accor Live Limitless, Choice Privileges, IHG One Rewards or Shangri-La Circle to Velocity and receive a 30% bonus on top. Allow up to 60 days for points to credit to your Velocity account.
terms: Participating programs: Accor ALL, Choice Privileges, IHG One, Shangri-La Circle. Allow 60 days to credit.

title: 4,000 bonus Velocity Points with Virgin Wines
description: Join the Virgin Wines Discovery Club and earn 4,000 bonus Velocity Points — 15 bottles of wine for $89, plus 3 Velocity Points per dollar spent on future purchases.
terms: Introductory offer: 15 bottles for $89. Ongoing 3 pts per $1 spent.

title: Up to 20% bonus Velocity Points on credit card transfers
description: Earn up to 20% bonus Velocity Points when transferring from participating credit card rewards programs. Enrol in auto-transfer by 30 June for the 20% bonus; manual monthly transfers earn 10%.
terms: 20% for auto-transfer enrolment by 30 June; 10% for manual monthly transfers.

title: 3,000 bonus Velocity Points with Inspiring Vacations
description: Link your Inspiring Vacations account to Velocity Frequent Flyer and earn 3,000 bonus points. Also earn 1 Velocity Point per dollar on future bookings, with Points + Pay redemptions starting at 5,000 points.
terms: Account linking required. Points + Pay from 5,000 Velocity Points.

title: 10,000 bonus Qantas Points via Sniip bill pay
description: Earn 10,000 bonus Qantas Points when you pay 3 bills totalling $2,500 or more through the Sniip app within 60 days. Use promo code POINTS10K when signing up.
terms: Promo code: POINTS10K. 3 bill payments totalling $2,500+ within 60 days required.

title: 60,000 Everyday Rewards points with Bupa health cover
description: New Bupa health insurance customers earn 60,000 Everyday Rewards points (worth $300) for individuals, or 120,000 points ($600) for couples and families. Use code EVERYDAY120. Minimum 60-day policy stay required.
terms: Promo code: EVERYDAY120. Couples/families earn 120,000 points. 60-day minimum stay required. New customers only.

title: Up to 10,000 Qantas Points with Red Energy
description: New Red Energy customers in ACT, NSW, VIC, SA and QLD earn up to 10,000 Qantas Points on electricity and up to 5,000 on gas. Points credited within 21 days of your first bill payment.
terms: ACT, NSW, VIC, SA, QLD only. New customers only. Points within 21 days of first bill.

title: 1,000 bonus Velocity Points with Foxtel Now trial
description: Earn 1,000 bonus Velocity Points when you start a free 10-day Foxtel Now trial. Mobile verification required. Points post within 30 days.
terms: Free 10-day trial. Mobile verification required. Points post within 30 days.

title: Up to 3,000 Velocity Points per month with AGL
description: New AGL Mobile or NBN customers earn up to 3,000 bonus Velocity Points per month for 6 months. Mobile: Small=1,000, Medium=2,000, Large=3,000 pts/month. NBN: Fast=1,000, Superfast=2,000, Ultrafast=3,000 pts/month.
terms: New AGL customers only. Points for 6 months. Offer may be withdrawn at any time.

title: Accor ALL — 2,000 bonus points + Gold status with Explorer
description: Join the ALL Accor+ Explorer membership and receive 2,000 bonus ALL Reward points (worth approximately $69 / €40 in hotel credit) plus automatic Gold status. Explorer membership includes a complimentary annual night.
terms: Accor+ Explorer membership required (paid). Gold status included automatically.
